# ICCAQI 2026: International Conference on Computing, AI, Quantum Intelligence and Future Technologies

> Organized by Yenepoya School of Engineering & Technology, Yenepoya (Deemed to be University), Mangaluru, Karnataka, India.
> Conference Dates: November 6–7, 2026
> Participation Mode: Hybrid (In-Person at Mangaluru Campus & Virtual Online Presentations)
> Official Website: https://yenepoya.edu.in/iccaqi-2026
> Secretariat Email: iccaqi2026@yenepoya.edu.in

## Conference Overview
ICCAQI 2026 invites original research contributions from academicians, researchers, industry professionals, research scholars, and students in the areas of Computing, Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Intelligence, and Emerging Technologies.

## Conference Tracks
- **Track 1: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning**
  Deep learning architectures, neural networks, natural language processing, computer vision, automated reasoning, reinforcement learning, explainable AI, and trustworthy AI.
- **Track 2: Quantum Computing and Quantum Intelligence**
  Quantum algorithms, quantum cryptography, quantum machine learning, quantum error correction, fault-tolerant quantum architectures, and quantum information science.
- **Track 3: Cyber-Physical Systems and IoT**
  Smart sensor networks, edge intelligence, industrial automation, robotics, autonomous systems, embedded intelligence, and secure IoT architectures.
- **Track 4: Next-Generation Computing Architectures**
  High-performance computing (HPC), distributed ledger technologies, cloud-native virtualization, green computing, neuromorphic computing, and 6G communication networks.

## Important Dates (Deadlines)
- Full Paper Submission: October 10, 2026
- Acceptance Notification: October 20, 2026
- Registration Deadline: October 25, 2026
- Conference Dates: November 6–7, 2026

## Publication Opportunities
- **Category I: Conference Proceedings & Double-Blind Peer-Reviewed Journals**
  - Abstracts published in conference proceedings with free soft copy & e-certificate.
  - Consideration in associated double-blind peer-reviewed journals without additional APC.
  - Plagiarism index below 20%, AI-generated content below 30%.
- **Category II: Scopus-Indexed Book Chapters and Journals (Optional Pathway)**
  - Optional publication pathway in Scopus-indexed book series chapters or journals.
  - Scopus Book Chapter: ₹9,750 additional publication charge.
  - Scopus Journal: ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 depending on Scopus quartile (Q1–Q4).
  - Stricter plagiarism threshold: Plagiarism below 10%, AI-generated content 0%.

## Registration Fees
- Students / Research Scholars: ₹1,500 (Domestic) / $50 (International)
- Academicians / Faculty: ₹2,000 (Domestic) / $75 (International)
- Industry Professionals: ₹3,000 (Domestic) / $100 (International)
- Attendee / Listener Only: ₹1,000 (Domestic) / $30 (International)
